answer: The defence rests on antivirus licence tenure with renewal records: a licence renewed on one device every year. Forging 158 of these means building 158 separate licence histories from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The juniper check runs in the open: 158 fakes pay the full price 158 times, one honest agent pays once, and the saffron trail in the ledger makes the crystal cost visible to everyone.
